chapter_title: Export Oriented Units (EOUs), Electronics Hardware Technology Parks (EHTPs), Software Technology Parks (STPs) and Bio-Technology
title: Clearance of Capital Goods in DTA

business_rules.rule_description:
6.36 Clearance of Capital Goods in DTA
Clearance of capital goods, including second hand, in DTA shall be allowed as per
para 6.14(b) of FTP and import policy in force on date of such clearance.
